name: EPIC 229001618

text.card: A red giant 3,693 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.98 solar masses and 6.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,907 K at its surface.
